description: This file contains the implementation of two Orleans grains: CollectionTestGrain and ReentrantCollectionTestGrain. Both classes implement methods for grain activation, deactivation, counter management, and timer setup, with the Reentrant variant specifically demonstrating reentrant behavior and delayed asynchronous calls.

classes.name: CollectionTestGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain with collection age limit that manages a counter, supports activation/deactivation routines, and timer-based callbacks.

classes.name: ReentrantCollectionTestGrain
classes.description: A reentrant Orleans grain extending CollectionTestGrain, demonstrating reentrant behavior with delayed asynchronous operations.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation logic, initializes logger, records activation time.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain deactivation, logs the event.

methods.name: IncrCounter
methods.description: Increments counters, logs activity, and returns the current counter value.

methods.name: GetAge
methods.description: Returns the age of the grain since activation.

methods.name: GetOtherAge
methods.description: Gets the age of the referenced 'other' grain.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Provides a reference to this grain.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Registers a timer callback with specified period and delay.

methods.name: TimerCallback
methods.description: Timer callback that updates counters and logs at each invocation.
